name: Claude Code Quota Badge
description: Surfaces your Claude Code subscription usage (weekly/monthly % used + burn-rate pace) as a first-class SecondStatusLine segment. Declares `provides.statusline.command`; aish core (TASK-318, SPR-073) runs the vendored cclimits.sh (dandaka/ccquota, MIT) on its own ~10-min cadence off the turn loop, caches the one-line badge in memory, and folds it onto the status line. Core owns cadence, cache, timeout, and staleness — the plugin just prints a badge line. Migrated from the Phase 1 TurnEnd-hook + file-convention design.
